headlines.title: Capital Group Dividend Value (CGDV) Buys $146.3 Million More AMAT on Nov. 2
headlines.summary: The fund bought $146.3 million of Applied Materials and $135.8 million of FTAI Aviation while selling $558.0 million of Alphabet, for net sales of $328.8 million.

headlines.title: ETFs Bought $237.0 Million of Applied Materials (AMAT) on Nov. 2
headlines.summary: ETFs added $237.0 million of Applied Materials stock, with 51 funds buying and 26 selling.

headlines.title: Applied Materials Just Dropped 29% In a Month: Will November 12 Earnings Rescue or Break AMAT Stock?
headlines.summary: Applied Materials has shed nearly a third of its value in a single month, and the chip equipment giant's November 12 earnings report now stands as either the catalyst for a recovery or proof the selloff has further to run.

headlines.title: Did Earnings Growth Just Shift Applied Materials (AMAT) Investment Narrative?
headlines.summary: Applied Materials recently reported 41% growth in adjusted earnings per share and 52% DRAM revenue growth, while continuing to invest in capacity, hybrid bonding technology and a larger stake in Besi, all against a backdrop of sector wide ETF selling and a sharp October pullback in the stock.

description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides materials engineering solutions, equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor and related industries in the United States, China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS) segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment includes semiconductor capital equipment to enable materials engineering steps, including etch, rapid thermal processing, deposition, chemical mechanical planarization, metrology and inspection, wafer packaging, and ion implantation. The AGS segment offers integrated solutions to optimize equipment and fab performance and productivity comprising spares, upgrades, services, and 200 millimeter and other equipment and factory automation software for semiconductor and other products. It serves manufacturers of semiconductor wafers and chips, and other electronic devices. Applied Materials, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
